chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever does not make a bequest for his relatives at the time of his death has indeed concluded his deed with an act of disobedience.

key_terms.عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ: at the time of one's death
key_terms.يُوصِ: to make a bequest or will

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about not making a bequest for relatives before death?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the importance of making a bequest for one's relatives at the time of death. It presents neglecting this duty as a serious moral and legal failing, showing the weight Islam places on family responsibility and end-of-life obligations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5415 - Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah narrated from Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
"Whoever does not make a will for his relatives at the time of his death has concluded his deeds with disobedience."
